placeholder.description: Placeholder text shown inside the input when empty

readonly.description: Render the field in read-only mode

width.description: Named width (xs, sm, md, lg, xl, full) or any CSS value

styles.description: Inline CSS style object applied to the field wrapper

customRender.description: Name of a globally registered Vue component to render instead of the default input

resource.description: Relative path to a resource.json used to populate the options

labelKey.description: Object key used as the display label

valueKey.description: Object key used as the stored value

uri.description: Remote endpoint URL for fetching options

dataField.description: Field in the API response containing the data array

clearable.description: Show a clear button to remove the selected value

storeValue.description: Store option[valueKey] instead of the whole option object

title: Crouton fieldInput options: select
description: Options for the select dropdown and multi-select (mutliSelect alias)
